comment: The neutron's conversion as the two hands declare it (the advisor's (c), #1572 comment 5963954612, 01:15 UTC; the mathematician's 204, 5964082980, 01:35 UTC, with the pair's number; the two hands' agreement on the one-Node lay, the mathematician's 205 item 3, 5964520368, and the advisor's second, 5964754600; the owner's words of 2026-10-03, 03:26 Israel and 00:52 UTC, build and run tonight; ALGEBRA.md, A family's declaration, item 5, The conversion's table and rate, and The click is the meeting, what the click's picture derives of the conversions): the universe file `universe` beside this design holds the rule's own rows (gravity, the sign holder `charge` at the level weight 1 and the write weight 1, the binding holder) and four rows of quanta, `neutron` [-4800, 6000] of three real lines (cos omega_n = -0.8, omega_n = 2.498, past pi / 2: the pair runs the act's test and claims nothing of the neutron's mass or its excess), `proton` [0, 6000] of three planes reading the sign holder (the frozen row, omega_p = pi / 2), `electron` [4000, 6000], matter's plane reading the sign holder (omega_e = 0.841), and `antineutrino` [6000, 6000], one real massless line, neutral. One body of the neutron of count 1 at the centre Node `centre` of the open `shape` cube, declared with its `conversion` (the table `table`: the rate in intervals per expected conversion, a declared integer, nature's 880 s read in as a declaration, and the families of the records out) and its own `node_reader` (the window 1, the seed and the generator), so that the engine lays it at the start by the invariant over its three lines (A_l^2 = T den div (2 s x 3), 95 per line) at its one Node, its six Link factors 0 by the declaration (it stays, as every record declared a NodeReader does), and at every window's end draws the conversion's list of the one click act between the list (the neutron whole at -1, its hole its lay at the count 0; the proton, the electron and the antineutrino at +1, one whole quantum each laid at the Node by the count as the engine's generic act lays every given quantum, at its family's massless pair [den, den], A^2 = T div 2 = 16,384, A = 128, every laid line of the record alike (the symmetric lay, A_l^2 = T div (2 laid)): a real line at the two levels alike, (128, 128), and a plane on its two lines with the sense the table's entry declares for it (`to`: {family, sense}, the proton -1 and the electron +1, the mathematician's 244 item 3), the real line (A_l, 0) and the sense line (0, sense x A_l), the quarter turn at which the share reads the count and the Wronskian sense x A_l^2 per plane, the electron's 128 and 16,384, the proton's 73 per plane and -15,987 over its three (round F of 2026-10-03): a one-Node lay of an open-Link record is a delta over the whole band and carries no frequency, the lay by the count at one Node reads the share 1 per quantum, and A^2 = T / (2 sin Omega) is a packet's amplitude, several Nodes along the emission's direction, the next round's; the frozen taker at R = 0 monochromatic and unchanged) and nothing, at the weights [1, rate - 1]. The hands' numbers of the rotations stand in `table` and `excess` as the design's derivations (the antineutrino carrying the rest at the excess Omega_nu = omega_n - omega_p - omega_e = 0.086, the pair [5978, 6000], A_nu = 436 at a packet's amplitude), read against the levels the lay gives. The trials: the world run once per seed of `trials.seeds`, each over `trials.intervals` intervals with the record's generator at the state the trials tool sets (the seed times the records declared NodeReaders, 1, plus the record's number, 0; tools/meeting_trials.py), the conversion read from its line; the realised conversions over the trials against N p with p = 1 - (1 - 1 / rate)^intervals, within sqrt(N p (1 - p)). The reading (`read_world.py` beside this design): over the first seed's run and the first converting seed's, at the start and at the conversion's interval, every family's lines at the Node (levels now and before, the remainders), each record's rotation read from its levels (cos omega = before / now on a real line, (re re_b + im im_b) / (re^2 + im^2) on a plane), the Wronskian per family at the Node, the books' counts and the credit's counts, the share per family at the Node and over the board in the current's units and in quanta beside the count, the energies T sin omega in and out, the back-in-time gate before the conversion, after it and across it; over every seed the conversion's interval. Every number stands here and the engine reads none; the blind below is the hands', verbatim as the Boss relayed it, written before any lay and never edited after.

amplitude_per_line.formula: A_l^2 = T den div (2 s x 3), s the fixed point of den^2 - num^2 = 3600
amplitude_per_line.value: the fixed point of the division act on 9102: 95; the levels (95, -76) on each line

to.amplitude_per_plane: A_l^2 = T / 6 = 5461, A_l = 73; the levels (73, 0) and (0, -73) on each plane
to.laid: by the count at the Node, every plane alike at the table's sense -1: each plane at (73, 0) and (0, -73), A_l^2 = T div 6 = 5461 by the fixed point of the division act, the share 0.976 of a quantum, the Wronskian 3 x (-73^2) = -15,987

to.amplitude: A^2 = T den div (2 s) = 21982 with s = 4472, A = 148; the levels (148, 98) and (0, 110)
to.laid: by the count at the Node at the table's sense +1: the plane at (128, 0) and (0, 128), A^2 = T div 2, the share 1, the Wronskian 16,384

to.amplitude: A^2 = T den div (2 s) = 191625 with s = 513, A = 437 (the hands' 436 by the real root), under the bound 9266; the levels (437, 435)
to.laid: by the count at the Node: the first line at (128, 128), A^2 = T div 2

rate_expectation.rate_not_a_power_of_two: the declared generator's low bits cycle with the period of a power of two, so a rate of 32 would convert every trial deterministically; 30 is declared

worlds.neutron_conversion: the neutron of count 1 at the centre with its table and rate

blind.counts: the counts per family by the row: the neutron 1 to 0; the proton, the electron and the antineutrino 0 to 1 (the advisor's (c), 5963954612)
blind.wronskian: the Wronskian sum conserved, the proton's and the electron's senses opposite (5963954612)
blind.rotations: the rotations summing exactly at the Node, omega_n(0) = omega_p(k) + omega_e(k) + omega_nu(k), asserted, the sines' difference booked and reported by name (5963954612); the mathematician's 204 (5964082980) on the pair: the antineutrino carries the rest at the excess Omega_nu = omega_n - omega_p - omega_e, [-4800, 6000] giving omega_n = 2.498, the excess 0.086 and A_nu = 436 at a packet's amplitude against the electron's own 148 at count 1
blind.rate: the realised conversions over the run within sqrt(N p (1 - p)) of the declared rate (5963954612)
blind.back_in_time: the back-in-time tool crossing from the lines (5963954612)
blind.share: the share 1 per quantum at the Node, the books and the share agreeing: a one-Node lay of an open-Link record is a delta over the whole band and carries no frequency; the generic act lays by the count at one Node, A^2 = T / 2 for any open-Link family; A^2 = T / (2 sin Omega) is a packet's amplitude (several Nodes along the emission's direction, the next round's) and at one Node reads the share 1 / sin Omega; the frozen taker at R = 0 is monochromatic and unchanged (two hands: the mathematician's 205 item 3, 5964520368, and the advisor's second, 5964754600, withdrawing his expected sin Omega)
blind.energy: the energies T sin omega reported as not conserved in this universe: 0.600 T in against 1.745 T and more out, the sines falling past pi / 2 while the rotations add; conserved at nature's gaps (two hands, 5964520368 and 5964754600)
blind.not_a_blind: the electron's spectrum: no wave number in the one-Node lay (201 B)
blind.caution: with the electron at omega_0 = 0.84 and the proton at pi / 2 the neutron's rest rotation lies past pi / 2, where T sin omega_0 no longer measures the energy; the pair runs the act's test (the counts, the rotations' sum, the rate, the books) and claims nothing of the neutron's mass or Q; the physical conversion is the small-gap universe's, by name (5963954612, 5964082980)
